title: ArchitectureContract
description: TOGAF-sourced directive archetype — formal joint agreement governing architecture development, quality of service, and cross-organizational commitments. Architecture Contracts are binding governance instruments that formalize agreements between architecture stakeholders regarding deliverables, quality, and fitness-for-purpose. Requires GSM unsealing of Directive to be functional. Extends Directive with TOGAF Architecture Governance vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Contract (Architecture Governance — Architecture Compliance, Interoperability). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Governance, Contract Management).

contractType.description: Type of architecture contract. DEVELOPMENT = governs architecture development projects. SERVICE = governs service delivery and quality. INTEROPERABILITY = governs cross-system integration agreements. COMPLIANCE = governs adherence to standards/regulations. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Contract type classification.

scope.description: Contract applicability scope. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Contract governance scope.

bindingLevel.description: Enforcement level of the contract. MANDATORY = binding on all parties. ADVISORY = recommended but not enforced. TOGAF mapping: Contract enforcement classification.
